Brief: "a plain wall fills the working area" becomes the realistic classroom desk the notebook, tags and bill lie on; empty backdrop behind the whole working area, the same in every phase
images.prompt: A smooth light-wood classroom desk top, pale honey laminate with fine natural grain and a soft satin sheen, seen from directly above in soft even daylight, completely empty, calm and even from end to end.

images.why: Opening "a classroom desk with a squared notebook and a pencil": a pencil lying at rest beside the notebook as a still prop (the writing pencil is the action kit)
images.prompt: A single new yellow hexagonal wooden pencil lying flat, sharpened to a fine graphite point with a bare wood cone, a small dark-grey ferrule and a pink eraser at the other end, a glossy painted body.

images.why: Stage "The amber price tags hang on a shelf ... one tag for each amount": a blank paper price tag for each amount in phase 1 and the Show tags button; the amount is drawn in code
images.prompt: A single plain blank cream kraft-paper hang tag with clipped top corners, a small reinforced round hole near the top with a short loop of natural jute string through it, a smooth empty paper surface.

images.why: Phase 4 "a shop counter holds a bill, a note and a purse beside the board": the closed leather purse beside the bill; the notes and amounts are drawn in code
images.prompt: A small soft tan-brown leather coin purse, the whole purse in full view with every edge, corner and the rounded bottom visible, a rounded flap with neat darker stitching, a matte grained leather surface and a plain brass clasp, small in the frame with a wide even border of empty white all round it.

images.why: Phase 4 "a bill ... beside the board": the blank shop bill slip that carries the story's amounts; every figure on it is drawn in code
images.prompt: A single blank shop bill slip on pale butter-yellow paper with a soft pink stripe along its torn zig-zag top edge, a narrow rectangle with a smooth, completely empty matte surface and clearly visible slightly shadowed paper edges.
